page.name: farm_dashboards_access
page.div: Layer and broiler farms are run by different teams: enable the Flock / Layer Dashboard for the layer team, the Broiler Dashboard for the broiler team, both for the general farm managers. Each also shows the reports of its kind (layer: daily egg production, egg production and egg stock analysis, pre-laying flock investment; broiler: broiler lifecycle investment). The user must also be a Farm Operator / User; the investment reports stay reserved to Farm Managers and accounting.
